Command: cd /workspace/project && cat -n split_lines.sh && echo '---' && ./split_lines.sh $'first\nsecond\nthird'
Read-only: false
Sandbox: disabled
Exit code: 0

STDOUT:
     1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# split_lines.sh: print every field of the first argument on its own line
     3	IFS=$'\n'
     4	read -r -a parts <<< "$1"
     5	for p in "${parts[@]}"; do
     6	  echo "[$p]"
     7	done
---
[first]
